title: Grateful Dead Live at Cleveland Public Hall on 1972-10-28

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording with a high‑energy show highlighted by a strong Phil Lesh performance
ai_review.review: The lone five‑star review is enthusiastic, noting a "philo stomp" that points to an especially powerful bass presence. While no specific songs or technical details are mentioned, the rating and the .sbd designation suggest a crisp soundboard source and a high‑energy performance.

ai_rating.rationale: A single five‑star review indicates strong approval of both the music and recording, but limited commentary reduces confidence to medium.
